sections.name: default export
sections.title: Tool card details
sections.what: Gives the tool's slug, name, subtitle, LIVE status, radar icon and path. The tools list uses these to show the card and link to the tool.
sections.why: Likely reason: the card can be shown without loading the page code.
sections.watch_out: The path must be the slug under the tools route, or the registry will reject the tool.

summary: A small description of the Reality Scan tool that the tools list reads without loading the full tool.
purpose: Gives the tools list the name, subtitle, status, icon and path it needs to show the tool card.
why: Likely reason: the registry loads these small descriptions up front, so the list appears fast, while the full page loads only when opened. Not stated directly.
how: It imports the radar icon and the tool type, then exports one object with the slug, name, subtitle, status, icon and path.
inputs: None at run time. The values are fixed in the file.
outputs: One descriptor object that the registry reads.
risks: The same values also appear in the index file. If the slug, name, subtitle or path changes in only one place, the card and the page will disagree, and the registry may reject the tool.
debug: If the tool is missing from the list, check that slug and path match the folder name and the index file. Look for the registry error text about invalid tool registration.
